findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink

Untrusted content: post_magic_link_v1_auth_magic_link_post, list_events_route_v1_events_get, get_event_route_v1_events__event_id__get, search_v1_search_get · Private data: post_magic_link_v1_auth_magic_link_post, get_taxonomy_v1_taxonomy_get · Public sink: post_magic_link_v1_auth_magic_link_post.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
